baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Smartwatch Charger (Charger). An inductive-type smartwatch charger consisting of a circular plastic molded housing (C962 Module Top Cover), a magnetic charging module, a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), and a permanently affixed USB electrical cable with a USB Type C connector. It plugs into a USB socket to wirelessly charge a user's smartwatch placed in alignment with the concave surface of the charging module. The Smartwatch Charger (Charger) is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from China and Vietnam.

The C962 magnetic charging module and C962 printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) are produced in China. The Circular plastic molded housing (C962 Module Top Cover), USB electrical cable and USB Type C connector are produced in Vietnam. 

Final assembly in Vietnam: Program the C962 PCBA; Solder the PCBA to the electrical cable; Insert the C962 charging module into the plastic housing; Solder the individual cable wires to produce a functional inductive charging device.

key_factors: The printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) and magnetic charging module
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the PCBA and magnetic charging module in China
prediction.reasoning: Following precedent N333268, the essential character of an inductive wireless charger is imparted by its functional core: the PCBA and the magnetic charging module, both of which are produced in China. The operations performed in Vietnam—programming the PCBA, inserting the module into the housing, and soldering the cable wires—constitute simple assembly and finishing that do not result in a substantial transformation of the Chinese-origin components.

verdict.reasoning: In N333268, CBP ruled on a nearly identical inductive wireless charger assembled in Vietnam from a plastic housing, magnetic charging module, PCBA, and USB-C cable. CBP held that simple assembly in Vietnam did not substantially transform the components and that the magnetic charging module established the essential charging function, conferring Chinese origin. Similarly, in N331943 and N335537, manufacturing the PCBA and inductive charging module conferred origin. In Variant B, both the C962 magnetic charging module and the C962 PCBA—along with all other components and final assembly—are produced in Vietnam, shifting the country of origin from China to Vietnam.
